title: software3d
responsibility: Render a simple projected game scene on a 2D canvas when a WebGL renderer cannot be created.

inputs.name: software3d.canvas
inputs.description: Browser canvas that receives the native scene or supplies game-only video frames.

outputs.name: software3d
outputs.description: Canvas renderer exposing projected scene rendering and disposal when WebGL cannot be used.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The browser cannot provide a 2D drawing context for the fallback renderer.
